question: 4x V100-SXM2-16GB (TP=4) 部署 27B NVFP4 模型的理论峰值吞吐量上限：受限于 V100 Tensor Core 对 FP16/BF16 的支持及 NVFP4 反量化开销，实际可持续吞吐量约为 15-20 tokens/s (per sequence)，在 max-num-seqs=8 并发下总吞吐约为 120-160 tokens/s，显存占用率 >95% (KV Cache 占主导)，导致无法增加 batch size 以提升利用率。

sources.snippet: Hardware and build. The release used 4× V100-SXM2 32GB (NVLink, TP4), 62 GB reported host RAM, ECC on, 877 MHz memory, up to 1530 MHz core, and a 300 W limit. The wheel is built from cb97f379b for CUDA 12.8. The three profiles use FP16 compute, up to eight scheduled sequences, a 4096-token prefill budget, and a 262144-token service limit.
